objective_value: <float> Number of vehicles used, which is the primary quantity being minimized.
num_vehicles: <int> Number of vehicle routes dispatched from the depot.
routes: <list[list[int]], length num_vehicles> Ordered sequence of node identifiers visited on each route, starting and ending at the depot (node 0).
total_distance: <float> Sum of Euclidean distances traveled across all routes.
departure_times: <dict, key: '{customer}'> Time at which the vehicle departs from each customer.
loads: <dict, key: '{customer}'> Cumulative demand aboard the vehicle when it departs from each customer.
